title: How we rebuilt all 50 coins in our idle game as real 3D metal with Claude Code and Blender
author: BrownaroStudios
selftext:
Mint Master is an idle game about running a coin mint. Our last update rebuilt all 50 coins as real 3D metal, using Blender with Claude Code writing the scripts.

What worked:

1. **One script, 50 data files.** Each coin is just its metal, rim, lettering and emblem. A change to the whole set is one rerun.
2. **Headless Godot for the odd jobs.** It turned the SVG emblems into height maps for the relief.
3. **Check at phone size.** Silver blew out to flat white small, so pale metals got a darker field.

Free on [iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mint-master-coin-tycoon/id6785648862?ct=aigamedev_2026_10_15&pt=128973167) and [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.brownaro.mintmaster&utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=aigamedev_2026_10_15).

Anyone else making art from scripts instead of prompts? How do you keep a set consistent?
